name: Artemis Robotics Sponsorship
subject: Artemis (Chatham) Robotics Sponsorship
message:
Good afternoon,

I'm Reed Fisch, Captain of Artemis 6621, a high school robotics team from Chatham New York. We have quintupled our enrollment in four years and doubled in size since last season alone, which has necessitated a rapid increase in our fundraising needs.

Last year, our team of 14 (competing against teams of 100+) won our regional and advanced to the World Championship in Houston, where we served as the Alliance Captain for the highest-scoring alliance in our division, and ended up ranked 3rd in the state.

Moreover as 42% of districts are on free or reduced lunch we refuse to charge our students a single cent to participate.

We believe that talent is universal but opportunity is not, so we are raising $65,000 to return to worlds and provide our team with the hardware and support we need to succeed. We hope you will be able to support us.

Best,

Reed Fisch

Our website, https://reedfisch.github.io/artemis-website/
